response.sql: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(o.scan_count) AS average_scans, AVG(o.gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute, AVG(o.gb_per_minute - b.all_operator_gb_per_minute) AS average_excess_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats AS o CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE o.gb_per_minute > b.all_operator_gb_per_minute

assumptions.assumption: A scan means one row in scans; zero-duration rows have an undefined rate and are ignored when averaging rates.

alternatives.interpretation: Count the scans represented by scancount in each row, rather than counting rows.
alternatives.sql: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS scan_count, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(o.scan_count) AS average_scans, AVG(o.gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute, AVG(o.gb_per_minute - b.all_operator_gb_per_minute) AS average_excess_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats AS o CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE o.gb_per_minute > b.all_operator_gb_per_minute
